entities.summary: Anthony Ike Fuller is an American former professional basketball shooting guard who spent one season in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Detroit Pistons (1980–81). He attended Pepperdine University, where he was drafted by the Pistons in the fifth round of the 1980 NBA draft. He was varsity basketball coach at Brophy College Preparatory in Phoenix, Arizona from 2006 to 2015.
